status: Internal population plan fixed after algebraic derivation and before the first numerical grid. Previous two-point row-weight results and informal analytic approximations were already known. No external preregistration.
question: Maximize the existing compensated-logit existence boundary under a fixed regular covariance multiplier, and compare globally optimized weights with the previous power-weight path at the same budget.
scale_normalization: Divide every law by sqrt(E D^2), preserving the whole-utility including fitted-intercept convention.
correction_power: Existing oracle variance rule tau/(1+tau), fixed for each population comparison.
primary_program: Maximize sum p_j J(x_j) subject to norm(sqrt(p)*x)<=sqrt(C)*sum p_j D_j x_j and x>=0. The effective row weight is x_j/D_j up to a common factor.
comparator: Largest power exponent r in[0,1] whose full regular covariance multiplier is at most C, with its own optimized profile scale.

numerical_conventions.feasibility_repair: If necessary, mix toward the strictly feasible unweighted ray, then optimize only the common radial scale.
numerical_conventions.check: Strong-concavity/KKT upper-gap diagnostic plus feasibility; independent solver and integration are separate.

claims_to_test: finite-support convex reformulation and positive unique optimizer

closed-form limiting budget curve and minimal covariance budget
continuity toward the limiting curve as auxiliary ratio grows
simulation_status: No new finite-sample simulation is planned in this file. Any illustration selected from population calculations needs a separately frozen plan and transparent selection rule.
